_note: Every public binary asset and the workspace it was captured from. A guard reads this because a name rendered into pixels cannot be found by searching text. The build copies this file into the published directory beside the assets it describes.
captured_by: scripts/capture-marketing-shots.mjs and scripts/capture-film-plates.mjs cut every still and every film plate from the running application; scripts/render-film.mjs composites the plates over a branded canvas one frame at a time; scripts/build-film-audio.mjs synthesises the score. Nothing here was recorded off a screen by hand. RECAPTURED 2026-09-17 against a demonstration workspace whose project customers are invented too: they previously named real federal organisations — a squadron, two Corps districts, a NAVFAC command and a VA health care system — beside invented contract values, and the walkthrough showed one of them full size for ten seconds. scripts/build-og-card.mjs composes the social card from brandWordmark() and the theme tokens; nothing in it is photographed. RECAPTURED 2026-09-18 against the same demonstration workspace after its portfolio was grown from six invented projects to twenty-four, so the counts on every screen are the product's own arithmetic over a company the size of a real one rather than over a sample. The walkthrough was re-recorded the same day: the PURSUE click in beat five is a genuine state change filmed on camera, "No decision recorded" becoming "Pursuing since 2026-09-18" — which it could not be while a decision from an earlier session sat in the demonstration store.
viewport: 1440x900 at 2x (2880x1800) for every still, so the set reads as one product; the walkthrough is recorded at 1440x900 and the hero loop is scaled from it to 1200x750
